matching_prs.title: Honest Python floor, manual local runtime verifier, real-engine D1/KV doubles and R2 SQL guard fix
matching_prs.classification: Explicit verification and test-quality changes in a combined PR
matching_prs.weakness: The CLI fuzz test ran a fixed 1,000-iteration loop, invoked the CLI twice per iteration and ended by checking that its outcome counter was nonempty. Failures could not shrink. The local verifier also waited for a timeout after the development server had already exited.
matching_prs.attempted_remedy: Keep the CLI invariants, generate and shrink argument lists with Hypothesis, pin three boundary examples and set a reproducible default budget. Fail immediately on server exit. Keep the five-example runtime exercise manual and add cheap tests for two failures it exposed. The PR also incorporates the separate suite repairs in #3.
diff_evidence: test_cli_random_argument_fuzz now generates argv lists up to eight atoms and calls assert_cli_invariants once. The Counter and final assert outcomes are gone. conftest.py defines 100 derandomized examples by default and a 2,000-example on-demand profile.

wait_until_ready checks proc.poll() during startup. The packaging guard parses each example's TOML and compares the exact set missing allow-build with two named exceptions. The runtime-shaped Response double checks the status type and the observed 201 and default 200 responses.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Preserve the actual behavior assertion when converting a random loop to a shrinkable property. Record the counterexamples worth running every time. When an expensive integration check exposes a defect, capture that specific failure in the fast suite.
matching_prs.outcome_verification: Merged 2026-10-11. GitHub Actions run 38054033053 at head c93d256 records a successful checks job and Tests step. That run did not start a Worker. The Response double copies an SDK signature and cannot detect later signature drift. The reported test counts and local timings were not independently reproduced.

matching_prs.title: Test audit: real-engine D1/KV doubles and R2 SQL guard fix
matching_prs.classification: Dedicated test audit, later incorporated into #2
matching_prs.weakness: D1 fakes returned fixed rows regardless of the query. KV fakes allowed paging tests to pass without following a real second page. The queue test accepted any sent message, the worker ID test compared an identical call to itself, and a status test read back values it had just supplied.
matching_prs.attempted_remedy: Replace fixed and recording doubles with in-memory SQLite and a stateful KV paginator. Assert rollback, bound values, full traversal, exact queue effects and worker ID sensitivity. Pin per-case error codes, parse catalog JSON, add negative verifier cases and delete the status field-echo test.
diff_evidence: test_d1_batch_is_atomic makes the second insert violate a constraint and queries for any surviving first insert. test_kv_iter_keys_follows_cursors_to_the_end lists seven matching keys three at a time with an unrelated key present.

The queue test checks the exact payload, separate ack/retry outcomes and a 120-second retry. Worker IDs must stay stable for equivalent code and change for different code. The catalog test decodes JSON and checks the name field. The status diff removes test_checkpoint_and_batch_result_share_status_vocabulary and retains Progress.percent boundary tests.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Choose test data and doubles that produce different observable results when an argument is ignored, paging stops early or an operation partially commits. Drop field-echo assertions that protect no independent behavior.
matching_prs.outcome_verification: GitHub marks #3 closed without merge. Commit 74e6c2a in #2 has #3 head e618307 as a parent, and #2 contains the same test changes. The Tests step passed on #3's head. The author reports detection rose from 6/18 to 18/18 planted bugs and checked doubles against Miniflare. The probes were not committed, and live Cloudflare conformance was not established.
